# pliability

> The #1 mobility and recovery app providing personalized daily routines, assessments, and guided workouts for individuals and teams.

pliability is a comprehensive mobility and recovery platform trusted by athletes, first responders, military personnel, and corporate teams. The app features daily stretching routines, injury prevention programs, and partnerships with major fitness organizations like HYROX, complemented by a retail shop offering specialized training equipment and apparel.

## Key Topics

- Mobility Assessment
- Recovery Training
- Stretching Routines
- Injury Prevention
- Guided Workouts
- HYROX Partnership
- Race Preparation
- Wellness Platform
- HSA/FSA Reimbursement
- pliability Mat
- Team Wellness
- Fitness Training
- Account Management
- Getting Started
- Troubleshooting

## Core Platform

- [pliability // #1 Mobility & Recovery App](https://pliability.com): Homepage for pliability mobility and recovery app with daily routines.
- [pliability Mobility Test | Measure your mobility in 3 minutes](https://pliability.com/mobility-test): Mobility assessment tool providing personalized mobility score and plans.
- [pliability for Teams // Mobility + recovery for business and teams](https://pliability.com/teams): B2B offering for teams, first responders, military, and workplace wellness.

## Partnerships & Events

- [pliability x HYROX // Official stretching + mobility partner of HYROX](https://pliability.com/hyrox): Official HYROX partnership page with race-prep and recovery programs.
- [pliability Ventures // Investing in human performance](https://pliability.com/ventures): pliability Ventures investment arm for fitness and sports medicine.

## Shop & Merchandise

- [pliability® Shop | training mats, mobility gear + apparel](https://shop.pliability.com): E-commerce shop for pliability training mats, gear, and apparel.
